_comment: Product-name normalization for the vendor/product KEV report. Keys are lowercased raw KEV product names; values are the canonical display name. Matching is per-vendor and case-insensitive, so pure case differences need no entry here.

Cisco.ios, xr, and xe software: IOS, IOS XR, and IOS XE
Cisco.adaptive security appliance and firepowe: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
Cisco.secure firewall adaptive security applia: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)
Cisco.small business rv320 and rv325 dual giga: Small Business RV320 and RV325 Routers
